abstract: Gestational Trophoblastic Disease (GTD) originates from placental tissue and is among the rare human tumors that can be cured even in the presence of widespread metastases. GTD include a spectrum of interrelated tumors including complete and partial hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumor, that have different propensities for local invasion and spread. Although most GTD develop after a mole, they can follow any antecedent pregnancy.Transvaginal ultrasound, routinary dosage of beta-hCG and current approaches to chemotherapy, let most women with malignant gestational trophoblastic disease to be cured and their reproductive function preserved.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)は胎盤組織に由来し、広範な転移があっても治癒しうる稀なヒト腫瘍の一つである。GTDには、完全および部分胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍など、相互に関連した腫瘍群が含まれ、それぞれ局所浸潤と播種の傾向が異なる。大半のGTDは胞状奇胎の後に生じるが、どの妊娠後にも発生しうる。経膣超音波検査、β-hCGの定期的な測定、および現行の化学療法により、悪性の妊娠性絨毛性疾患の女性の大半は治癒し、生殖機能を温存できる。
